gate: L8 early realism per part group at form (two independent judge passes; PASS = <= 1 single-judge FAKE per group; both FAKE after the one allowed fix round = stop)
judges: two fresh general-purpose subagents per round, image sheets only (review/l8/judge*_<group>.png), no other context; round 2 told that straight-down parallel legs are the owner's decision (Q2)

chassis.notes: uniform hard chamfers on slab faces, faceted bands on the forend top; zig-zag notches on the top line behind the action (trace stair-steps)

bolt group.notes: constant-diameter handle rod into the body with no forged root; perfect-ball knob

bipod.notes: no visible yoke / body; legs read as stacked tubes; both wanted splayed legs (contradicts the user's Q2 = straight down)

fix_round: bipod: a real yoke (rear web behind the knuckles + two outboard pivot cheeks |Y| 29.5..32.4 carrying the leg pins, all below Z -54 so the bracket still cants +-15 under the forend); pin heads outboard of the cheeks; detent disks inside the cheeks
bipod feet: two moulded tread rings
bolt handle: tapered stem from a forged root (r 6.0 -> 4.7 -> 4.0) into the knob
chassis / butt / riser: 1.0 x 45 edge breaks (spec 0.6; declared), the top line behind the action rebuilt as a clean machined step (X 244.8..346: Z -14 -> ramp -> -10.5)
shading: stale bevel custom normals cleared, face-area weighted normals at 100 (the SMG gunlib 0.2.1 lesson)

top_fixes: pocketed / contoured butt, riser adjustment hardware visible, a recoil pad with a curved profile and joint line
bolt body detail visible when open (lugs are inside the receiver even at full travel: guide rib / flutes are real-pattern options), shaped shroud
tactical (tapered, flat-faced) knob instead of a sphere: the sheet draws a ball, kept
each leg top as a visible machined knuckle / clevis around the pin with a retaining clip; a spring or detent housing; a chamfered pocketed yoke body

bipod.note: one single-judge FAKE (allowed); the knuckle / spring-housing fix is the first W4b close-up item
